info.name: AssignMate API
info.description:
REST API for **AssignMate** - students post assignments, verified experts bid, deliver, and get paid out of escrow.

### Base URL
Everything lives under `{{baseUrl}}` = `{{serverUrl}}/api/v1`. The health check is the one exception and sits at `{{serverUrl}}/`.

### Roles
`STUDENT` | `EXPERT` | `ADMIN`

### Auth
`POST /auth/login` returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken, role }` in the body **and** sets both as httpOnly cookies. Protected routes accept either the cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header - this collection sends the bearer header from `{{accessToken}}`, which the login test script fills in automatically.

If the access token has expired but the refresh cookie is still valid, the `auth` middleware silently mints a new access token and returns it in the `x-access-token` response header.

Public routes (`Health`, all of `Auth` except `Get Me`, `Expert / Register`, `Expert / Verify`, `Assignment / Feed`, `Assignment / Get By Id`, `Payment / Callback`, both `Review` reads) are marked **No Auth** individually.

### Suggested run order
1. `Health / Health Check`
2. `Auth / Register User` -> `Verify Register OTP` (paste the emailed code into `{{otp}}`)
3. `Auth / Login` as the student - fills `{{accessToken}}`
4. `Assignment / Create Assignment` - fills `{{assignmentId}}`
5. `Auth / Login` as the expert -> `Bid / Make Bid`
6. `Auth / Login` as the student -> `Bid / Get Bids By Assignment` -> `Accept Bid`
7. `Payment / Initiate Checkout` -> pay on the bKash page (bKash calls the callback)
8. `Auth / Login` as the expert -> `Assignment / Submit Assignment`
9. `Auth / Login` as the student -> `Assignment / Assignment Action` (`COMPLETED` releases escrow)
10. `Review / Write Review` as the student, then `Get Expert Reviews` (public)
11. `Escrow / Get Escrow Vault` as any party, `Payment / Payment History` as the student or an admin
12. `Escrow / Revenue Analytics` as an admin

Because tokens are per-role, re-run `Auth / Login` with the matching credentials whenever the role changes.

### Multipart routes
`POST /expert/verify`, `POST /expert/student-register`, `POST /assignment/create` and `PATCH /assignment/:id/submit` are `multipart/form-data`. The JSON payload goes in a **single text field named `body`** (stringified JSON) - that is what `multipartDataValidationZod` parses. Files go under `documents` (max 5) or `attachment` (single). Leave `Content-Type` unset so Postman can add the boundary.

### Pagination
List endpoints take `searchTerm`, `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder` and respond with:
```json
{ "data": [], "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 10, "total": 0, "totalPages": 0 } }
```
Query params are disabled by default - tick the ones you want.

### Success shape
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "...",
  "data": {}
}
```

### Error shape
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "name": "Error",
  "message": "...",
  "error": {},
  "stack": "..."
}
```
`name`, `error` and `stack` are only populated when `NODE_ENV=development`.

### Not covered here
- `student` has a route file in `src/app/module/student/` but it is empty and not registered in `src/app.ts`.
- `GET /assignment/dispute/:assignmentId` and `PATCH /assignment/dispute/:assignmentId/action` are registered in `assignment.route.ts` with `auth(Role.ADMIN)` **and no handler**, so a request to either passes the auth middleware and then hangs until the client times out. They are left out until a controller is attached.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Registration, OTP verification, login and token refresh.

Run `Login` before anything else - it fills `{{accessToken}}`.

request.description:
Creates the user in a pending state and emails a 6-digit OTP.

`role` is optional and defaults to `STUDENT`. Allowed: `STUDENT` | `EXPERT` | `ADMIN`.

Password: 6-64 chars. Name: 3-255 chars.

Confirms the emailed OTP and activates the account.

Paste the 6-digit code from your inbox into the `otp` collection variable first.

Returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken, role }` **and** sets both as httpOnly cookies.

The test script stores the tokens in `{{accessToken}}` / `{{refreshToken}}`, which the collection-level bearer auth uses for every other request. Run this first.

Swap the body to `{{expertEmail}}` / `{{adminEmail}}` to switch roles.

exec: console.warn("no token in response - tokens not updated");

request.description:
Current user with the `student` / `expert` profile joined in. Password omitted.

Any authenticated role.
Emails a password-reset OTP. Always returns 200.
Consumes the reset OTP and sets `newPassword` (6-64 chars).

Exchanges a Google ID token for app tokens; creates the user on first sight.

> **Known issue:** `authController.googleLogin` passes the whole `req.body` object into `authService.googleLogin(googleIdToken: string)`, so `verifyIdToken` receives an object and rejects the token. This route needs a controller fix (`req.body.idToken`) before it works.

Mints a fresh access + refresh pair.

Reads the token from the **`refreshToken` cookie only** (`req.cookies.refreshToken`) - a JSON body is ignored. Run `Login` in the same Postman cookie jar first so the cookie is present for `{{serverUrl}}`.

item.name: Expert
item.description: Expert onboarding, document upload and admin approval.

request.description: Starts expert signup and emails an OTP. Complete it with `Verify Expert`.

**multipart/form-data.** Confirms the OTP and creates the expert profile in `PENDING`.

- `body` - stringified JSON (see the pre-filled field)
- `documents` - up to 5 files (transcripts, ID, certificates)

Leave `Content-Type` unset so Postman adds the multipart boundary.

formdata.value:
{
  "email": "{{expertEmail}}",
  "otp": "{{otp}}",
  "university": "University of Dhaka",
  "department": "Computer Science",
  "ratePerAssignment": 1500,
  "bio": "5 years of tutoring experience in algorithms and databases."
}
formdata.description: Stringified JSON payload. multipartDataValidationZod parses this field.
Up to 5 files. Add the row multiple times for more.

request.description:
**multipart/form-data.** Lets an already-logged-in `STUDENT` open an expert profile - no OTP, the account is already verified.

Requires a `STUDENT` access token.

formdata.description: Stringified JSON payload. multipartDataValidationZod parses this field.

query.description: createdAt | updatedAt | university | department | ratePerAssignment | walletBalance | isVerified | verificationStatus

request.description:
Paginated expert directory. **ADMIN only.** Query params are Zod-validated, so an unknown `sortBy` returns 400 rather than a Prisma error.

The test script captures the first row into `{{expertId}}` for `Approve / Reject Expert`.

**ADMIN only.** Sets the expert's verification status.

`status` is upper-cased before validation, so `approve` works too.

Same endpoint as `Approve Expert` with `status: REJECT`.

`reason` is **required** when rejecting - the Zod refine returns 400 without it.

**multipart/form-data. STUDENT only.** Creates an assignment in `OPEN`.

- `body` - stringified JSON: `title` (3-200), `description` (10-2000), `budget` (> 0), `deadline` (ISO 8601, must be in the future)
- `attachment` - a single optional file, uploaded to Cloudinary

The pre-request script stamps a deadline 14 days out so the request never goes stale. The test script stores the new id in `{{assignmentId}}`.

formdata.description: Stringified JSON payload. multipartDataValidationZod parses this field.

request.description: Public feed of `OPEN` assignments - no auth required. This is what experts browse before bidding.
Single assignment by id. Public - no auth, no ownership check. 404 if it does not exist.

query.description: OPEN | ASSIGNED | AWAITING_PAYMENT | IN_PROGRESS | SUBMITTED | UNDER_REVIEW | COMPLETED | CANCELLED | DISPUTED

request.description:
Role-aware list. **STUDENT | EXPERT.**

- `STUDENT` - assignments they posted, with the assigned expert and a bid count
- `EXPERT` - assignments they **won** (`assignedExpertId`), with the student and accepted bid. Pending bids live at `Bid / Get My Bids` instead.

An `ADMIN` token gets 403 here.

**multipart/form-data. EXPERT only** (must be the assigned expert).

- `status: IN_PROGRESS` - marks work started; no file needed
- `status: SUBMITTED` - delivers the work; attach the deliverable as `attachment`

Only valid while the assignment is `ASSIGNED` or `IN_PROGRESS`.

formdata.description: Stringified JSON payload. multipartDataValidationZod parses this field.
The deliverable. Required when status is SUBMITTED.

request.description:
**STUDENT only** (must own the assignment). Drives the post-delivery state machine.

Allowed only while the assignment is `SUBMITTED` or `UNDER_REVIEW`:

- `UNDER_REVIEW` - student is reviewing the delivery
- `COMPLETED` - releases escrow, credits the expert's `walletBalance`, marks the escrow `RELEASED_TO_EXPERT`
- `DISPUTED` - **requires `reason`**, stored on `assignment.disputedReason`

Re-sending the current status returns 409.
Same endpoint with `status: DISPUTED`. `reason` is mandatory here - 400 without it.

item.name: Bid
item.description: Experts bid on open assignments; students review and accept one.

request.description:
**EXPERT only.** Places a bid on an `OPEN` assignment.

- `proposedAmount` > 0
- `estimatedDelivery` ISO 8601, must be in the future
- `coverNote` 10-1000 chars
- `assignmentId` must be a valid UUID

The pre-request script fills `{{estimatedDelivery}}` with a date 7 days out.

**STUDENT only.** Bids received on one of their own assignments (`PENDING` and `ACCEPTED` only - rejected bids are hidden).

The test script captures the first bid into `{{bidId}}`.
**EXPERT only.** Every bid this expert has placed, with the assignment joined in.

**STUDENT only.** Accepts a `PENDING` bid on an `OPEN` assignment.

In one transaction: the bid becomes `ACCEPTED`, every sibling bid becomes `REJECTED`, and the assignment moves to `AWAITING_PAYMENT`. Pay via `Payment / Initiate Checkout` next.
**EXPERT only.** Withdraws their own bid. Only a `PENDING` bid can be withdrawn.

item.name: Payment
item.description:
bKash tokenized checkout and payment history.

Flow: student accepts a bid (assignment -> `AWAITING_PAYMENT`) -> `Initiate Checkout` -> pay on the bKash page -> bKash hits `Callback` -> payment `PAID`, assignment `ASSIGNED`, escrow `HELD`.

request.description:
**STUDENT only.** Creates a bKash tokenized checkout for one of their own assignments and returns the `bkashURL` to redirect the user to.

A `Payment` row is created (or reused) with status `INITIATED`. Returns 400 if the assignment is already `PAID`.

No request body - the assignment id is in the path.

exec: if (typeof d === "string") console.log("open this url in a browser:", d);

request.description:
**Called by bKash, not by you.** Included for debugging.

On `success` it executes the payment, marks it `PAID`, flips the assignment to `ASSIGNED` and creates the `HELD` escrow row - then **302-redirects** to the frontend, so Postman shows the redirect target rather than JSON.

All three query params are required or the route 400s.

query.description: transactionId / bkashTrxId / merchantInvoiceNumber / payerReference / assignment title. ADMIN also matches the student's name and email.

request.description:
Paginated payment history, scoped by role. **ADMIN | STUDENT.**

- `STUDENT` - only payments on assignments they own, filtered server-side via `assignment.studentId`; each row includes the assignment summary
- `ADMIN` - every payment in the system, plus the owning student and their user name / email, and `searchTerm` additionally matches those

`sortBy` is whitelisted - anything else silently falls back to `createdAt`. An unknown `status` returns 400 listing the allowed values.

Responds with `data` + `meta { page, limit, total, totalPages }`.

item.name: Escrow
item.description:
Escrow vault inspection and platform revenue reporting.

An escrow row is created `HELD` by the bKash callback, and flips to `RELEASED_TO_EXPERT` when the student marks the assignment `COMPLETED` via `Assignment / Assignment Action`. `platformCommission` and `expertEarnings` are stored as **percentages** (15 / 85 by default).

request.description:
The escrow record behind one assignment, with the commission split resolved into amounts.

**ADMIN | STUDENT | EXPERT**, but scoped:

- `ADMIN` - any vault, and the response includes the owning `student`
- `STUDENT` - only assignments they posted
- `EXPERT` - only assignments they were assigned to

Anyone else on the record gets 403; a missing escrow is 404 (escrow rows are created by the bKash callback, so an unpaid assignment has none).

`breakdown` turns the stored **percentages** (`platformCommission` 15, `expertEarnings` 85) into `platformRevenue` / `expertPayout` using the same rounding as the payout in `Assignment Action`.

exec: pm.test("split adds up to the total", function () {

query.description: ISO date. Filters on escrow createdAt.
ISO date. Must be >= from, else 400.

request.description:
**ADMIN only.** Platform earnings rolled up across every escrow.

- `totals.grossVolume` - everything that ever entered escrow
- `totals.platformRevenue` - commission **realised** on `RELEASED_TO_EXPERT` escrows
- `totals.pendingPlatformRevenue` - commission still sitting in `HELD` escrows
- `totals.expertPayouts` - what experts have actually been credited
- `byStatus` - count + amount per `EscrowStatus`
- `monthly` - the same figures bucketed by the month the escrow was **funded** (`createdAt`), so a row's revenue is the share of that month's escrows since released

Both date params are optional; omit them for all-time.

item.name: Review
item.description: Students rate the expert once an assignment is `COMPLETED`; the reads are public so expert reputation can be shown to anyone browsing.

request.description:
**STUDENT only.** One review per assignment.

Guards, in order: the assignment must be **theirs** (404), must be `COMPLETED` (400), must have an assigned expert (400), and must not already be reviewed (409).

- `rating` - integer 1-5
- `comment` - optional, 3-1000 chars

Note `Review.studentId` stores the **User** id, while `expertId` is the Expert profile id.

query.description: Filter the list to one rating, 1-5

request.description:
Public expert reputation view - no auth. 404 if the expert id is unknown.

Returns the expert, a `summary` (`totalReviews`, `averageRating`, and a 1-5 `distribution`) and the paginated `reviews`.

The `rating` filter narrows **the list only** - the summary always reflects every review, so the star breakdown stays stable while you filter.

Public. The single review attached to an assignment (`assignmentId` is unique on `Review`). 404 when the assignment has not been reviewed.

Declared after `/expert/:expertId` in the router so `expert` is never read as an assignment id.
